{{VG}}
A '''Dart ''ter'angreal''''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that serves as a projectile weapon through the use of the [[One Power]]. It is only known to have survived the [[Breaking of the World]] in the [[Mirror World]] inhabited by [[Elayna]] Sedai.

== Appearance ==
True to its name, the Dart ''ter'angreal'' appears as a slender, ornately designed dart.

==Use==
The Dart ''ter'angreal'' is an offensive object that nevertheless is made for one particular purpose. Rather than enhancing the abilities of the user's weaves, it allows projectiles to be fired at enemies, making it a skilled weapon. 

The weapon had no ammunition and could effectively be used infinitely, but would often stop working for extended periods of time if around one hundred shots were fired from it in quick succession. While the weapon was effective against [[Shadowspawn]], individual attacks were weak, and individual [[Trolloc]]s would often only be felled after several uses of the weapon.<ref name="VideoGame">''[[The Wheel of Time (video game)|The Wheel of Time]]''. Red Eagle Games, 1999.</ref>

==History==
In a Mirror World, an [[Aes Sedai]] named Elayna encountered the Dart ''ter'angreal'' at a ''[[Tuatha'an]]'' camp outside [[Shadar Logoth]] which had been completely wiped out by Shadowspawn.<ref name="VideoGame"/>
